_readme: Maps a named resistance gene/allele (as it would appear in evidence_records.resistance_gene) to the UniProt accession AlphaFold DB needs. 'verified' means the accession was confirmed to be that exact gene product from a UniProt entry page, not guessed from a paper abstract. 'unverified' entries are commented out on purpose - copy one to the real list only after checking https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/<id>/entry yourself. Multiple UniProt entries sometimes exist for the same protein (independent submissions) - if AlphaFold has no prediction for the exact accession you find, try a close relative, but never assume it's an exact match and label it accordingly.

NDM-1.note: Carried over from the alphafold_client.py docstring example - re-confirm on UniProt before treating it as authoritative.

OXA-48.note: Two different UniProt entries turned up for OXA-48 (independent submissions are common for bacterial plasmid genes). Open both entry pages, check the sequence length/organism match your source paper's isolate, and confirm which one (if either) has an actual AlphaFold prediction before adding it above. Do not guess.
